Hi everyone, I’m Gahyun Lee, an independent student from South Korea.

I have been working on a Lean 4 / mathlib formalization project related to arithmetic “primality sheaf”-style certification. The current repository contains several integrated files, Spt1–Spt5, which currently build with lake build and are intended to be sorry-free and without project-level axioms. Spt6 is still in progress.

At this stage I am not claiming that the whole mathematical project is complete. I would like to get feedback on the Lean side: module structure, theorem statement design, naming, and whether some elementary algebra/number theory lemmas could be refactored into a more mathlib-friendly form.

What would be the best stream/topic to ask for this kind of project-level feedback?
